children: Pohanka previously held senior roles at Audi, Porsche and Jaguar Land Rover
Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles (VWCV) has appointed Martin Pohanka as Head of Design, placing him in charge of the brand’s overall design function.

Pohanka has been with VWCV since 2017 and most recently served as Head of Design Creation, overseeing interior, exterior, UI/UX and colour and trim. He will succeed in the role with extensive experience across the automotive industry, having previously held design positions at Audi, Porsche and Jaguar Land Rover.

He began his career in 1997 as a freelance industrial designer and joined Audi in 1998. He moved to Porsche in 2001, working across interior and advanced design, before joining Jaguar Land Rover in 2015 as Chief Designer of Interior Creation.

At VWCV, Pohanka initially led interior design before taking charge of Design Creation in 2023. His work has contributed to the design of models including the Multivan, ID. Buzz, latest Transporter generation and Amarok. His earlier work includes the Porsche 911, Boxster and Macan, as well as the Land Rover Defender and Range Rover.
